# Sources: the French-speaking market

Every source used in `README.md`, read on 2026-10-29. "Full" means the page or the relevant section was read in
full. "Summary" means only a search engine summary, a write-up by someone else, or a tool summary of the page was
read. "Failed" means the page could not be opened; what is said about it comes from secondary sources.

## Regulators and official bodies

| Source | URL | Read | One line |
|---|---|---|---|
| CNIL, Communications par voie électronique aux prospects et clients (page dated 10 June 2026) | https://cnil.fr/fr/node/168596 | Full | Current B2B conditions: job relevance, origin and purpose told, easy refusal; channels listed do not name social messaging |
| CNIL, Les règles d'or de la prospection par courrier électronique (2009) | https://cnil.fr/fr/les-regles-dor-de-la-prospection-par-courrier-electronique-0 | Full | Older B2B wording: subject related to the recipient's functions; sender identity in every message |
| CNIL, Recommandations pour les réutilisateurs de données publiées sur internet (June 2024), use-case sheet 2 (PDF pages 43 to 50) | https://www.cnil.fr/sites/cnil/files/2024-06/recommandations_reutilisateurs_donnees_publiees_sur_internet.pdf | Full (sheet 2) | Reasonable expectations, source terms, professional network content, information within one month and at first contact |
| CNIL, Recommandations reutilisateurs, landing page | https://cnil.fr/fr/recommandations-reutilisateurs-donnees-internet | Full | Index of the four use-case sheets, 12 June 2024 |
| CNIL, La réutilisation des données publiquement accessibles en ligne à des fins de démarchage commercial (30 April 2020) | https://www.cnil.fr/fr/la-reutilisation-des-donnees-publiquement-accessibles-en-ligne-des-fins-de-demarchage-commercial | Full | Public data is personal data; general terms acceptance is not consent; inform at first contact |
| CNIL, Aspiration de données : sanction de 240 000 euros à l'encontre de la société KASPR (19 Dec 2024) | https://cnil.fr/fr/aspiration-de-donnees-sanction-de-240-000-euros-lencontre-de-la-societe-kaspr | Full | SAN-2024-020: restricted-visibility LinkedIn contact data beyond reasonable expectations; four breaches |
| CNIL, Reconstitution d'adresses électroniques professionnelles (16 Oct 2026) | https://cnil.fr/fr/node/169044 | Summary | Guessed work addresses; already covered in ../cold-email |
| Nestor decision SAN-2020-018 (8 Dec 2020), via Maddyness and enforcement tracker | https://www.maddyness.com/2021/01/07/cnil-amende-nestor-mails-600000-personnes/ | Summary | EUR 20,000 for prospecting emails without consent |
| CPCE L34-5, via Baumann avocats and Journal du Net summaries | https://www.baumann-avocats.com/CPCE/article-l34-5-du-code-des-postes-et-des-communications-electroniques.php | Summary | Sender identity must not be hidden; subject must relate to the offer |
| LCEN 2004 definition of courrier électronique, via LAGBD | https://www.lagbd.org/Loi_pour_la_confiance_dans_l%27%C3%A9conomie_num%C3%A9rique_(fr) | Summary | Broad definition (text, voice, sound, image stored until fetched) |
| OQLF, Contextes d'emploi du vouvoiement et du tutoiement | https://vitrinelinguistique.oqlf.gouv.qc.ca/25140/la-redaction-et-la-communication/protocole-et-activites-publiques/contextes-demploi-du-vouvoiement-et-du-tutoiement | Full | Vous at first meeting; tu common in workplaces; senior proposes the switch; Quebec more tu than elsewhere |
| BAKOM / OFCOM, When is mass sending allowed (2 July 2021) | https://www.bakom.admin.ch/en/when-is-mass-sending-allowed | Full | Swiss UCA art. 3 (1)(o): opt-in for mass advertising, sender named, easy refusal |
| Certified Senders Alliance, legal situation for email marketing in DACH | https://certified-senders.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/The-legal-situation-for-email-marketing-in-Germany-Austria-and-Switzerland.pdf | Summary | Swiss rule applies to B2B and B2C alike |
| CRTC, CASL FAQ | https://crtc.gc.ca/eng/com500/faq500.htm | Failed (403, again on 2026-10-29); quoted via search summary | LinkedIn messaging counts as sending to an electronic address |
| CRTC infographics and Bennett Jones on conspicuous publication | https://www.bennettjones.com/fr/Insights/Blogs/CRTC-Assesses-Conspicuous-Publication-Basis-of-Implied-Consent-in-CASL-Enforcement-Decision | Full | Implied consent needs no "no solicitation" statement and role relevance; third-party publication alone is not enough; does not mention LinkedIn |
| Younity (Nicolas Roland) on Lexgo, Email marketing reminder (30 May 2017) | https://www.lexgo.be/en/news-and-articles/4554-email-marketing-kind-reminder-of-what-you-need-to-consider | Full | Belgium: no opt-in for legal entities only where contact details are not linked to an individual |
| Belgian DPA opinion on the Royal Decree of 4 April 2003 | https://www.autoriteprotectiondonnees.be/publications/avis-n0-02-2026.pdf | Summary | Rules now in the Code of Economic Law VI.110 and following |
